description: Loads a Workday RaaS NDJSON worker extract from GCS into the bronze Postgres layer (raw_worker_events + rejects). The silver SCD-Type-4 merge is applied afterwards by the launcher via a Postgres procedure.
name: Workday HR NDJSON to Bronze

parameters.helpText: gs://bucket/path/workers_YYYYMMDD.ndjson — one worker JSON object per line
parameters.label: Input NDJSON file
parameters.name: input_file

parameters.helpText: uuid5 of the file sha256, computed by the launcher; drives idempotency
parameters.label: Content-addressed file UUID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.label: Secret Manager resource for the Postgres DSN
parameters.name: pg_dsn_secret
